夏晚安停下脚步，扭头。她的视线先落在了韩经年的身上，不过只是短短的一瞬，她就落在了张特助的脸上。只见张特助笑的面若桃花般，冲着自己扑了过来：“夫人，今天是周末，您应该没什么事吧，既然没事，您看，您就陪韩总参加晚会好了……”张特助边说，边像是拜菩萨般，双手合十的不断鞠着躬：“夫人，这次真的是紧急情况，您要是不帮忙就真的没人能帮忙了，夫人，俗话说得好，救人一命胜造七级浮屠，所以拜托您了，您的大恩大德，我铭记于心，将来您让我做牛做马我都毫无怨言……”这个问题，好像不是他和她能决定的吧？夏晚安想着，就又看了一眼韩经年，男人没开口阻拦张特助的意思，但脸上的神情也没表现出来特别需要她帮忙。张特助见夏晚安不说话，以为她是不情愿，一边在心底佩服着夫人果然就是夫人，不为韩总美色所动，一边晃着身子，继续求：“拜托，夫人，拜托，拜托拜托拜托……”张特助这模样，若是背后再多一个尾巴，就真跟给主人讨骨头卖萌撒娇的哈巴狗没区别了。夏晚安一是被他吵的脑壳疼，二是怕自己看着他这副模样没忍住笑了，便出了声：“我是没意见，只是，你老板……”“夫人，只要你没意见，老板肯定也没意见！”张特助脱口而出了这句话后，才意识到自己好像越权了，便赔着笑，转身看了一眼书桌前坐着的韩经年：“对吧？韩总？”韩经年没着急开口。夏晚安紧张的指尖掐住了掌心。她刚刚是不是被张特助求的太没主见，答应的太草率了？万一他拒绝了她，那她……在她胡思乱想之时，韩经年面无表情的轻点了一下头，然后丢给张特助一句“你看着办吧”，就低头去看电脑了。见韩经年恩准了，搞定最棘手事的张特助，暗松了一口气，望着夏晚安喋喋不休了起来：“夫人，我先带您去楼下用早餐，用完后，我带您去做个护理吧？您这么漂亮，再好好的护理一下，你肯定就是今晚那颗最闪亮的星！”说着，张特助就指了指门口，示意夏晚安跟自己一起走。“光做护理还是不够的，得做个造型，还有礼服，等下我让人把礼服送来，您挑挑看……对了，夫人，您的尺寸是多少呀？还有鞋码……”门关上了，房间里彻底安静了下来。盯着电脑看的韩经年，抬头往门口看了一眼，过了会儿，他低头目光像是在看电脑，又像是在走神，又过了好一会儿，他修长漂亮的手，落在键盘上，敲敲打打了起来。…在张特助的安排下，夏晚安这个周末过得比平时上班时还繁忙，等她收拾妥当，再见到韩经年时，已经是傍晚六点钟，距离晚会开始只剩下一个半小时。

Chapter 25 The brightest star tonight 1 (Page 1)
Xia Wan'an stopped and turned his head. Her eyes first fell on Han Jingnian, but only for a short moment, she fell on Zhang Teshu's face. I saw Zhang Teshu smiled like a peach blossom and rushed towards me: "Madam, today is the weekend. You should have nothing to do. Since you are fine, you can accompany Mr. Han to the party..." As Zhang Teshu said, he kept bowing with his hands clasped together as if worshiping a Bodhisattva: "Madam, this time it really is In an emergency, if you don't help, no one will really be able to help. Madam, as the saying goes, saving one life is better than building a seven-level pagoda, so please, I will bear in mind your great kindness, and I will have no complaints if you let me work as a cow or a horse in the future..." This question doesn't seem to be decided by him and her, right? Xia Wan'an thought about it and glanced at Han Jingnian again. The man didn't mean to stop Assistant Zhang, but the look on his face didn't show that he needed her help. Seeing Xia Wan'an's silence, Zhang Teshu thought she was unwilling. He admired in his heart that Madam was indeed the Madam and was not moved by Mr. Han's beauty. He shook his body and continued to beg: "Please, Madam, please, please, please, please..." Zhang Teshu looked like this. If there was another tail behind his back, he would be no different from a pug begging for bones for his master to act cute and coquettish. First, Xia Wan'an's head hurt from his quarrel, and secondly, she was afraid that she couldn't help laughing when she looked at him like this, so she said, "I don't have any objection, but your boss..." "Madam, as long as you have no objection, the boss must have no objection either!" After Special Assistant Zhang blurted out these words, he realized that he seemed to have exceeded his authority, so he smiled apologetically and turned to look at Han Jingnian sitting at the desk: "Right? Mr. Han?" Han Jingnian didn't speak in a hurry. Xia Wan'an pinched her palm nervously with her fingertips. Was she too unassertive when being asked for help by Zhang Te, and her consent was too hasty? If he rejects her, then she... While she was thinking wildly, Han Jingnian nodded his head expressionlessly, then said to Assistant Zhang, "You can figure it out," and then lowered his head to look at the computer. Seeing that Han Jingnian had agreed to handle the most difficult matter, Special Assistant Zhang secretly breathed a sigh of relief. He looked at Xia Wan'an and started to chatter non-stop: "Madam, I will take you downstairs to have breakfast first. After that, I will take you for some nursing care? You are so beautiful. If you take good care of yourself, you will definitely be the brightest star tonight!" With that, Assistant Zhang pointed at the door and motioned for Xia Wan'an to come with him. "Nursing alone is not enough, you have to have a look and a dress. I'll have the dress delivered later and you can take a look... By the way, madam, what are your measurements? And your shoe size..." The door closed and the room became completely quiet. Han Jingnian, who was staring at the computer, raised his head and glanced at the door. After a while, he lowered his gaze as if he was looking at the computer or distracted. After a while, his slender and beautiful hands fell on the keyboard and started typing. ...Under the arrangement of Special Assistant Zhang, Xia Wan'an spent this weekend busier than usual at work. By the time she finished packing and saw Han Jingnian again, it was already six o'clock in the evening, and there was only an hour and a half left before the party started.
